app.abyss.empty: No Abyss record yet — not cleared or data is private
app.alert.noData: No data yet — waiting for the admin to refresh
app.alert.noUid: Set the game UID and server in Tapp settings

app.alert.ltoken: Cookie is missing ltoken/ltoken_v2 (required by game record APIs). Unbind and scan again, or paste a cookie that contains ltoken

app.toast.riskCooldown: Risk cooldown active — try again in {time}

app.qr.title: QR bind
app.qr.tip: Scan with the miHoYo app and confirm on your phone
app.qr.scanned: Scanned — please confirm on your phone
app.qr.bindNoData: Bound, but data verification failed — tap Refresh later to retry
app.qr.error: Bind failed — retry or paste a cookie manually
app.qr.noLtoken: QR confirmed but no ltoken was obtained — retry or use a cookie that contains ltoken
app.qr.incomplete: QR confirmed but no valid credential was returned — retry, or check debug info if it keeps failing
app.admin.note: Cookie and account settings (UID / server / device info) are stored in installation-scoped private data readable only by owner/admin. A dedicated alt account is recommended. Game record APIs (resin/characters/Abyss) require ltoken or ltoken_v2, which QR login fills automatically; a cookie_token-only cookie can only read BBS profile data.
app.admin.settingsInvalid: Invalid settings: UID must be digits and device info must be valid JSON
